responsibility: Contains the Xstormy16 RTL machine description that drives instruction selection, recognition, splitting, attributes, and assembly output for this target. It defines instruction and expansion patterns for moves, arithmetic, branches, bit-test operations, push/pop forms, peepholes, and branch-length/PSW attributes, and it ties those patterns to the predicates and constraints from predicates.md and constraints.md plus helper expanders/output routines implemented in stormy16.cc.
same_name_distinction: Holds the declarative RTL machine description for Stormy16—define_insn, define_expand, peepholes, and instruction attributes that drive recognition and selection—and calls out helper routines implemented in stormy16.cc. Unlike stormy16.cc, it is not C++ hook code; unlike stormy16.h, it does not establish target macros and ABI constants; unlike stormy16.opt, it does not define user-visible command-line options.
